crm.ab.anonymous_hint: The visitor did not give marketing consent, so no contact data was kept.
crm.ab.caption: Abandoned bookings

crm.ab.empty_hint: Booking-engine sessions that reach a quote and stop for 45 minutes appear here.
crm.ab.privacy_body: Contact details are stored only when the visitor consented to marketing. Without consent the record stays anonymous: stage, dates and value only. Transactional contact is not marketing.

crm.comm.basis_hint: Marketing to the guest needs their consent for that channel.
crm.comm.body_hint: What was said or agreed. Do not write card numbers or passwords.
crm.comm.empty_hint: Calls, notes and messages logged by staff appear here.
crm.comm.log_desc: This records a contact that happened outside TEX. Nothing is sent to the guest.
crm.comm.log_title: Log a call, note or email
crm.comm.no_consent: The guest has not consented to marketing by {channel}. Choose another legal basis or channel.
crm.comm.subject: Subject
crm.consent.ack_grant: The guest gave this consent themselves after seeing the consent notice above.
crm.consent.ack_withdraw: The guest asked to withdraw this consent (or I am correcting a wrong record).
crm.consent.confirm_desc: Consent changes are legal records. They are saved with your name, the time, the source and the notice version.
crm.consent.legal_1: Marketing consent is given per channel and is separate from transactional messages. Booking confirmations, payment links and stay information are sent to perform the contract and need no marketing consent.
crm.consent.legal_2: Under KVKK (Law No. 6698), the GDPR and, in Türkiye, the e-commerce law (No. 6563), consent must be freely given, specific, informed and unambiguous. Record how it was given and which version of the consent notice the guest saw.
crm.consent.legal_3: Withdrawing consent must be as easy as giving it and takes effect immediately. Every change is kept in the history below, and marketing exports include only guests who consented to that channel.
crm.consent.legal_title: KVKK / GDPR: how marketing consent works
crm.consent.none_hint: No marketing consent on any channel
crm.consent.requested_hint: Asked for in an online booking made with this guest's e-mail or phone. Not applied: record it once the guest confirms it on a verified channel.
crm.consent.source_hint: How did the guest express this choice?
crm.consent.subtitle: Marketing permission per channel
crm.consent.text_version_hint_grant: The version of the consent / privacy notice the guest agreed to.
crm.consent.title: Consent
crm.consent.transactional_note: Transactional messages (confirmations, payment links, stay information) do not depend on this consent.

crm.edit.blacklist_hint: Blacklisted guests are never exported for marketing.

crm.export.subtitle: Marketing lists (CSV) per channel
crm.export.title: Export
crm.export.why_counts_differ: Exports contain only segment members who consented to marketing on that channel and are not blacklisted. That is why each channel can show fewer guests than the segment has.

crm.loyalty.no_program: None of the guest's hotels runs a loyalty program.
crm.loyalty.points_invalid: Enter a whole number greater than zero.

crm.loyalty.member.join_desc: Join the guest only with their agreement: you are recorded as the one who joined them. A member gets the program's member prices at its hotels.
crm.loyalty.member.leave_desc: The guest is no longer a member and no longer gets member prices; their points stay theirs.
crm.loyalty.member.block_rejoin: Do not let them rejoin online
crm.loyalty.member.block_rejoin_hint: For a reason such as abuse. A join on the booking site will not make the membership active again; staff can still join the guest here.
crm.loyalty.member.join_lifts_block: This guest may not rejoin online. Joining them here lifts that block.
crm.sessions.title: Signed in on the booking site

crm.program.name: Name

crm.merge.title: Merge a duplicate into {name}
crm.merge.desc: The duplicate's records move to this profile and the duplicate is deleted.
crm.merge.source_hint: Its ID, e.g. G-00123. You need guest edit rights at every hotel either profile has records at.
crm.merge.what_moves: Stays, bookings, communications, abandoned bookings and loyalty points move here; the points become one balance and the tier follows it.
crm.merge.what_consent: Consent becomes the stricter of the two: a channel stays allowed only if both profiles allowed it.
crm.merge.what_final: This profile keeps its own details and takes the duplicate's only where it has none. The merge is audited and cannot be undone.
